attributes.law_screen: Screened all 14 core-screen laws via `laws --tag core-screen --full 1`. claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web (APPLIED, primary lever for the large majority of sites: bare-hex-to-offsetof spelling on the SAME raw pointer, no type change). claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast / claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing (APPLIED as a guardrail, not a lever: two attempts to introduce a typed alias -- a `DiagObjGlobals* wg` local declared at pbDiagDrawInfo's top, and a `wg->entries[gDiag_F4].obj` single-field member access replacing the offsetof form -- both regressed real 252->320 purely from the NEW DECLARATION shifting entry-schedule register allocation, even though the touched field count was ONE; reverted to the offsetof-on-raw-pointer form, which was clean. This is new evidence that the alias-risk laws' danger surface extends to entry-schedule disruption from the declaration itself, not just multi-field addressing loss). claim.law.pointer-walk-array-index-regression / claim.law.recomputed-index-array-form-safe (APPLIED as a guardrail: pbDiagDrawMenu's `*(u32*)((u8*)b+i*4+16)=*(u32*)((u8*)lbl_80240FB0+i*4)` loop is a RECOMPUTED-index case per the safe law's own criterion (i freshly used each iteration, no accumulator) - converting the LHS (b, the heavily-pressured buttons pointer) to array form `b[i+4]` regressed real 28->30 with an opcode-multiset DIFFERS verdict (stwx/lwzx -> stw+li/lwz+addi), contradicting the safe law's optimism for this specific base pointer; converting the RHS (lbl_80240FB0[i]/lbl_80240FA0[i], a small independent 4-word array) to the identical array form was clean. Net: array-index safety is base-pointer-specific, not just index-computation-pattern-specific - re-verify per pointer, not just per loop shape). claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier (APPLIED, new confirming instance: pbDiagDrawObject's three structurally-identical `*(f32*)((u8*)gDiag_FC+N)=*(f32*)((u8*)b+M)` mat/pad-view write sites - all offsetof, all pure spelling, zero shape change - showed 1-of-3 safe / 2-of-3 real+2 / 3-of-3 real+14 under bisection, an isolated-site regression class the parent law's evidence base did not previously show for the SPELLING-ONLY form, only for typed-member-access batches). claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention (screened: no p+=CONST load-update idiom sites were touched in this TU). claim.law.offsetof-fused-immediate-counter / claim.law.offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary (screened: no walked-pointer-plus-struct-level-2 or array-typed-struct-member bases were converted). claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form (screened: no adjacent raw-read-then-same-address-write pair was touched; pbDiagDrawAudio's snd/sub/voice reads and writes never share an address in one statement). claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity (screened: sAudioBankTable is the only base with a dual-symbol-style cross-TU identity question, resolved via the cross_tu_struct_discovery above rather than a relocation-target ambiguity). claim.law.dead-offset-shadow-removal-safe (screened: no shadow index variable became fully dead from these conversions). claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression (screened: no touched function exceeds ~4000 insns; fndiff --count real/insns checked after every batch regardless).
